integrity: All lattice indices, discriminants, incidence counts, and embedded-file hashes are recomputed from the supplied data. The abstract quotient facts used in the proof are attributed to the primary source; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The full lattice-generation statement is for a very general member of the displayed family.
The four face conics are required to be smooth; this is a nonempty Zariski-open condition.
No classification is claimed for Noether--Lefschetz specializations or degenerations of the face conics.
title: Sixteen visible rational curves generate the generic Klein-four quartic quotient lattice
